name: NoAutomationNotifications
tagline: Hides the Shortcuts "Running your automation" notification.

changelog.changes:
- Initial release.
- Hides the Shortcuts "Running your automation" notification and the "automations recently ran in the background" summary (iOS 15-17).
- Confirmation prompts ("Run" / "Don't Run") are kept.

name: FlicksForAll
tagline: iPad-like key flicks on iPhone

changelog.changes:
- Roothide build.
- Extra-light haptic option, smaller symbols by default.
- Fixed the character preview flickering while flicking.
- Dropped iOS 12/13 support, code cleanup.
Better logic distinguishes between flick and slide to type; fix preview glitch

New Flick Sensitivity presets (5 levels), haptic strength options and optional Feedback on Cancel, Symbol Size presets, export/import presets, reorganised settings with clearer descriptions, new settings icon

- Fixed settings not applying in sandboxed apps (Messages, Music, App Store apps…). Settings are now stored in a file inside jbroot instead of going through cfprefsd; existing settings are migrated automatically.
- Fixed flick symbols disappearing when the Symbol Size was set too small.
- No longer requires Cephei: the settings pane now uses plain PreferenceLoader, so Cephei can be removed if nothing else needs it.

- Re-tuned Flick Sensitivity presets: they are now evenly spaced, and the lowest setting no longer makes flicks nearly impossible to trigger.
- Settings: icons on each section, clearer descriptions (all settings below the test text field take effect immediately), copyright footer.

- Flicks now also work on the keyboard shown for Safari's address bar (the "AlphaWithURL" variant was previously skipped).
- Each keyboard variant now keeps its own default layout, and a keyboard is only patched once.

- New "Other Settings" section in settings. All off by default:
  - Hide Paste Permission Alert: skips the "Allow Paste" prompt (iOS 16+). Based on NoPasteAlerts16 by 0xkuj.
  - Hide "Pasted from" Banner: removes the "X pasted from Y" notice after pasting. Based on NoPastedFrom by Brend0n.
  - Hide Keyboard Settings in 🌐 Menu: removes Keyboard Settings, Dictation Settings and the one-handed keyboard buttons from the globe key menu. Based on NoKeyboardSettings by Brend0n.
  - Replace Dictation with Hide Keyboard: replaces the mic below the keyboard with the hide keyboard button; hold it to dictate (Face ID iPhones only).
- These options are based on NoPasteAlerts16, NoPastedFrom and NoKeyboardSettings, so FlicksForAll now conflicts with and replaces those tweaks.
New “Shift Delete” option in “Other Settings” (off by default): separate switches for Shift Hold + Delete and Shift Lock (Caps Lock) + Delete, which make Delete remove the word before the caret.

name: TabGuard
tagline: Control pop-ups and new tabs in Safari

changelog.changes:
- Initial release: successor to SafariBlocker by P2KDev (replaces SafariBlocker; its settings are carried over).
- Blocked pop-ups show a small banner above Safari's toolbar: Allow Once, Always Allow Pop-ups on This Site, or Block Pop-ups Silently (whole site, this page only, or this pop-up link).
- Whitelisted domains, blocked domains and blocked URLs can be managed, exported and imported in settings.

- Now supports iOS 15 (previously iOS 16+).
- iOS 15: fixed menu handling that is only available on iOS 16+, and the order of the pop-up banner's menu items.
- Code refactor. No functional changes.
- Performance improvements.

name: TapTapSlumber
tagline: Double-tap the lock screen or home screen to lock your device.

changelog.changes:
- Roothide build, source reconstructed from TapTapSlumber 0.0.3 by iGerman.
- Double-tap empty space on the Home Screen, or the Lock Screen (including the passcode page), to lock the device.
- New: Ignore Taps on Keypad, so typing a passcode quickly (e.g. "11") won't lock the device. Applies immediately; changing Home Screen / Lock Screen needs a respring.

name: PerAppKeyboard
tagline: Pick the keyboard each app starts on (per app, from your own keyboards).

changelog.changes:
- Initial release.
- Per app: a fixed keyboard (any iOS keyboard you have enabled), Last used in this app, or Don't change (the default, iOS decides).
- The keyboard goes back to the app's keyboard every time it appears; you can still switch with the globe key while typing.
- Choose what resets it: hiding the keyboard, going Home or to another app, locking with the power button.
- Master switch, also available as a Control Center toggle.
- Leaves password, number, URL and e-mail fields and hardware keyboards alone.
- Only stock iOS keyboards (from Keyboard Settings) are supported, not third-party ones.

name: SmoothCursor (iOS 13+)
tagline: Office 2013-styled cursor animation.

name: AutoPickUp
tagline: Auto answer incoming CallKit calls (Phone, FaceTime, Zalo, WhatsApp, Telegram...) after a delay, per app.

changelog.changes:
- Initial release, based on AutoAnswer9 by leftyfl1p (rewritten).
- Automatically answers incoming calls after a delay (0–40 s, default 10) for Phone, FaceTime and CallKit apps: Zalo, WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, Viber, Signal, LINE.
- Per-app mode: Off (default), Everyone (with excluded contacts) or Only Specific Contacts; match by phone number, caller name or pick from Contacts.
- Optionally switch auto-answered calls to the speaker, keeping headphones if connected.
- FaceTime video calls: don't answer, answer as audio only, or answer.
- Settings apply immediately, no respring needed.

- New: Answer with Volume Buttons. Press volume up or down to answer a ringing call instead of silencing it, for every app, even if its Auto Answer is off. Useful when the touchscreen doesn't work.
- Speaker option now also applies to calls answered with the volume buttons.
- Answer delay range is now 0–30 seconds (default 10).
- Code cleanup.

name: CCCalc
tagline: Turn the Calculator CC module into a working calculator

changelog.changes: - No ivars, button fix.

- Roothide build.
- Two-line display: the full expression (e.g. `2×(1+3)`) sits above the result, with long expressions scrolling to keep what you're typing visible.
- Proper order of operations with parentheses; `2(` means `2×(` and `200+10%` means 10% of 200, like the stock Calculator.
- Tapping `=` again repeats the last operation.
- New result history: tap an entry to copy it.
- Taller module with an extra row of buttons; very large or small results switch to scientific notation.

- Rebuilt for rootful, rootless and roothide; Qn added to the credits.
- No functional changes since 2.1.0.

- CCCalc now has its own Control Center module, so it can be added in Settings > Control Center without replacing another module. Compatible with [ControlCenter18](https://repo.ya-ebal.mom/) by evgeniy558.
- Better landscape layout.
- Ability to open the Calculator app on the Cover Sheet (Notification Center or lock screen).

name: TrueLink
tagline: Cleans copied links: resolves Google /goto, Reddit /s/ and amzn.to short links, unwraps redirects, strips tracking params.

changelog.changes:
- Initial release, inspired by CleanCopy by b4db1r3.
- Resolves short links (Google `/goto?url=`, Reddit `/s/`, `amzn.to`) to the real destination without opening the page.
- Unwraps redirects (`google.com/url?q=`, Google Ads, Facebook `l.php`, LinkedIn).
- Strips tracking parameters (`utm_*`, `fbclid`, `gclid`, `si`…) and share junk from Google, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X, Reddit, LinkedIn and Spotify.
- Shortens Amazon links to `/dp/<ASIN>`.
- Works system-wide, including links inside copied text. If resolving a short link fails or takes over 4 s, the original link is copied.

name: DateLyrics
tagline: Apple Music / YouTube Music (Experimental) lyrics in the Lock Screen date view!

changelog.changes:
- Roothide support.
- New: full-screen artwork mode, instrumental dots and idle ticker.

- New (Experimental): Smooth Word Sweep lights each syllable gradually over its sung duration, like Apple Music. Holds whole syllables while the screen is off (Always-On).
- New: Italic Lyrics option under Typography.

- Fixed a paused lyric reappearing on the Lock Screen after its pause timeout, for example when another app takes over playback.
- Smooth Word Sweep: the setting now notes its extra battery and GPU cost.
- Fixed Music crashing on iOS 16 when lyric timings or the playback position were invalid (NaN), e.g. while the queue reloads.

- New (Experimental): YouTube Music support. Off by default: turn on Enable YouTube Music Support in Settings → DateLyrics → Experimental, then respring.
- Lyrics come from YouTube Music itself and are fetched automatically for most songs; if a song shows none, open its Lyrics tab once.
- Unofficial and relies on the app's internals, so it may break at any time (tested on YouTube Music v9.41). No word highlighting or sweep, lyrics may drift on split lines, and Musixmatch Fallback is not supported.
- Experimental footers in settings are only shown while their switch is on.
- iOS 16.2 support for word-by-word lyrics

name: BetterTelex
tagline: Fix Telex re-composing words (what -> ưhat) after backspacing into them

changelog.changes:
- Initial release.
- Fixes the stock Vietnamese Telex keyboard changing words you already typed correctly when you go back to edit them (e.g. `what` no longer turns into `ưhats`, `isp` no longer becomes `íp`).
- Vietnamese words still get their tone marks fixed as usual.

- Experimental iOS 14 support (untested on real devices; falls back to stock keyboard behaviour if it can't read the composition state).
- Rootless and rootful builds available alongside roothide.

* Khôi phục từ Tiếng Anh (iOS 15+): Khi bấm dấu cách, “,” hoặc “.”, nếu từ vừa gõ có dấu mà không phải âm tiết tiếng Việt thì BetterTelex trả về đúng các phím đã gõ (ví dụ “does” không còn bị đổi thành “doé”). Dùng danh sách âm tiết hunspell-vi (GPLv2). Tham khảo từ dự án xmannv/xkey
* Telex đơn giản: Phím “w” gõ một mình giữ nguyên là “w” thay vì thành “ư” (ví dụ “what” vẫn là “what”); “uw” vẫn ra “ư”.
* iOS 14 trở xuống vẫn là thử nghiệm, iOS 15 chưa kiểm chứng. Đã test trên iOS 16 và 17.

- Fixed Safari's Downloads folder sometimes missing from Local Files Favorites: it is now looked up again if it wasn't found the first time.

name: TrueLink
tagline: Cleans copied links: resolves Google /goto, Reddit /s/ and amzn.to short links, unwraps redirects, strips tracking params.

changelog.changes:
- Initial release, inspired by CleanCopy by b4db1r3.
- Resolves short links (Google `/goto?url=`, Reddit `/s/`, `amzn.to`) to the real destination without opening the page.
- Unwraps redirects (`google.com/url?q=`, Google Ads, Facebook `l.php`, LinkedIn).
- Strips tracking parameters (`utm_*`, `fbclid`, `gclid`, `si`…) and share junk from Google, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X, Reddit, LinkedIn and Spotify.
- Shortens Amazon links to `/dp/<ASIN>`.
- Works system-wide, including links inside copied text. If resolving a short link fails or takes over 4 s, the original link is copied.

name: LSNowPlayingRepeat
tagline: Lock Screen and Control Center Now Playing get a Repeat button for Apple Music, YouTube Music and Spotify (tap = Off/All/One). iOS 17.1+: replaces Favorite, long-press = Favorite. iOS 16–17.0: replaces the audio output button, long-press = output picker.

changelog.changes:
- Initial release.
- Turns the Favorite (⭐) button in the Lock Screen and Control Center Now Playing controls into a Repeat button: tap to cycle Off → All → One, long-press to toggle Favorite.
- Works with Apple Music and YouTube Music.

- Repeat button now also works in Control Center's Now Playing module.
- StandBy and the Dynamic Island keep the stock Favorite button.
- Respring after installing or removing so Control Center picks up the change.
- Experimental Spotify support.

- iOS 16 support: on iOS 16.0–17.0.x the Repeat button replaces the audio output button, and long-press opens the output picker.
- iOS 17.1+ unchanged: replaces Favorite, long-press toggles Favorite.

name: BetterTelex
tagline: Fix Telex re-composing words (what -> ưhat) after backspacing into them

changelog.changes:
- Initial release.
- Fixes the stock Vietnamese Telex keyboard changing words you already typed correctly when you go back to edit them (e.g. `what` no longer turns into `ưhats`, `isp` no longer becomes `íp`).
- Vietnamese words still get their tone marks fixed as usual.

- Experimental iOS 14 support (untested on real devices; falls back to stock keyboard behaviour if it can't read the composition state).
- Rootless and rootful builds available alongside roothide.

* Khôi phục từ Tiếng Anh (iOS 15+): Khi bấm dấu cách, “,” hoặc “.”, nếu từ vừa gõ có dấu mà không phải âm tiết tiếng Việt thì BetterTelex trả về đúng các phím đã gõ (ví dụ “does” không còn bị đổi thành “doé”). Dùng danh sách âm tiết hunspell-vi (GPLv2). Tham khảo từ dự án xmannv/xkey
* Telex đơn giản: Phím “w” gõ một mình giữ nguyên là “w” thay vì thành “ư” (ví dụ “what” vẫn là “what”); “uw” vẫn ra “ư”.
* iOS 14 trở xuống vẫn là thử nghiệm, iOS 15 chưa kiểm chứng. Đã test trên iOS 16 và 17.

name: PleaseKeepLPM
tagline: Keep Low Power Mode on when charging past 80%

changelog.changes:
- Initial release.
- iOS turns Low Power Mode off once the battery charges past 80%; PleaseKeepLPM turns it back on automatically while the device is plugged in.
- Turning Low Power Mode off yourself (Control Center or Settings) is respected.
- Fixed SpringBoard crashing when PleaseKeepLPM turned Low Power Mode back on.
- Rewrote the code: Low Power Mode is now turned back on only when the system turns it off automatically, replacing the previous timing-based detection of manual turn-off.

name: PassBy
tagline: Bypass passcode in many ways

changelog.changes:
- iOS 15+ with rootless and roothide support.
- New: optional toast when the device is unlocked by a trusted WiFi network or Bluetooth device (with a test button in settings).
- Removed Activator integration and the CoverSheet auto-dismiss option.
- Bug fixes and cleanup.

- New (Experimental): guest passcode for lending your phone. It unlocks normally, re-locks after a set timeout (0 = never) and keeps auto-unlock off until you unlock with Face ID/Touch ID or your real passcode.
- The guest passcode must be numeric (4 or 6 digits) and the same length as your real passcode.
- Updated help page.

- The unlock toast now also shows "PassBy: Magic passcode" every time you unlock with the magic passcode (setting renamed to "Show unlock toast").
- Magic passcode unlocks are confirmed against the real lock state, since the unlock can finish asynchronously.

name: Tapbacks18
tagline: An attempt to bring the Tapbacks feature from iOS 18+ down to iOS 15 / 16 / 17.

changelog.changes:
- Group chat support: one circle per person like iOS 18, and the "who reacted" panel shows which emoji each person used.
- The "+" button beside the tapbacks is now a smiley button.
- Faster response when opening the emoji keyboard.
- New settings and package icons.
- Experimental iOS 15 support. Not tested on a real device yet, and the "Native emoji tapbacks" option (`Tapbacks18IDS`) is not available there.

- First stable release.
- Fixed Messages crashing when you open the tapback picker on a message you already reacted to with an emoji (for example to change or remove it). The heart is no longer shown as selected, and the smiley button now shows your emoji right away.
- Notifications and the conversation list preview now show the emoji tapback ("Reacted 🔥 to “…”") instead of "Loved …".
- iOS 15 support is still experimental.
- Tidier footer notes in settings.
- The emoji tapback text ("Reacted 🔥 to “…”") now follows the device language.

- Fixed the emoji button going off screen when the tapback bar is wide.
- Performance improvements.
